_comment: Build prompt 27, task 5 — a hand-labelled triage regression set (docs/plan-2026-h2.md P2). Started at 30 synthetic, clearly-labelled threads (not the full ~50 the build prompt names as a target); this set is meant to GROW from real, redacted decisions the same way evals/cases/ does, not to be padded with low-value synthetic filler to hit a round number. 'sender'/'tier' cases drive the deterministic importance-adjustment check (orchestrator.triage v3): 'tier' is the sender's simulated importance tier, 'expected_adjustment' is the direction a correct system must move the base classification.
